paras: The lynching of an unnamed Black man in Bosque County, Texas, was reported in March 1881 as the hanging by a mob of a man accused of raping a white woman. The only account found is one sentence in a column of state news in the San Marcos Free Press, which gives no name, date, or details of the killing.

On March 10, 1881, the San Marcos Free Press printed in its "Texas Review" column that "a negro who had ravished a white woman in Bosque county, was hoisted by Judge Lynch." "Judge Lynch" was the usual phrase for punishment by a mob without trial, and "hoisted" meant the man was hanged, though the item does not say outright that he died. The item names neither the man nor the woman, gives no town or date, and says nothing about who hanged him, how many took part, or whether he had first been arrested.
Because the column gathered recent state news, with other items dated late February, the lynching probably took place shortly before the paper was printed, but the date is not given.
No report of an inquest, arrests, or any official response appears in the coverage.

The San Marcos weekly ran the report as one line among routine briefs, between notice of a Bosque County man's suicide and an item about a mining company being formed in San Antonio. It stated the alleged rape as fact, identified the two people only by race and sex, and described the hanging with the euphemism "hoisted by Judge Lynch" without comment. No other newspaper report of the lynching was found.

bases: The only report says a Black man accused of raping a white woman 'was hoisted by Judge Lynch', the period's phrase for a hanging by a mob without legal process (A1).

'Hoisted by Judge Lynch' means a hanging carried out outside the law in answer to an alleged rape, so a killing, illegality and a pretext of justice are all implied (A1). The one-line brief gives no description of the people who did it or how many there were, and it does not state the death outright.
A single brief in a San Marcos weekly's column of state news is the only report found (A1).
